title: Normalized scalar and geometric realization of exceptional left models
statement: Fix a purity finite setting P, a separated quasi-compact locally finite-type model X0 over Spec(P.field.k0), a compactification c0 of its structure morphism, and the specified coefficient exceptional system S [def-sf-coefficient-endpoint-objects]. Ordinary realization data at X0 [def-sf-coefficient-realization-cohomology-data] admit functors from the actual native Weil-complex categories at X0 and at the model point to the coefficient Frobenius-pair categories [def-sf-native-derived-pair-cohomology]. The source model composed with the source realization is naturally isomorphic to native ordinary derived-pair forgetting. The target model sends the native point constant to the canonical coefficient constant as a pair. There is a natural isomorphism a: F_native VY ≅ VX F_coefficient between the underlying ordinary functors, with the left Frobenius equation F(theta_X(K)) a_K^{-1} = beta_{VX(K)}^{-1} T(a_K^{-1}) theta_Y(F_native K). Here F_coefficient and beta are the specified compact-support functor and exchange of [lem-pur-constant-purity-frobenius-square]. The same data retain a normalized Family [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data], its native exceptional-forgetting Package [def-sf-native-exceptional-forgetful-data], coefficient-change equivalences EX,EY from the P.coefficients.Qbar common-stage categories to the reference PadicAlgCl common-stage categories, an isomorphism c: EX F_reference ≅ F_coefficient EY, and native model comparisons x: VX EX ≅ V_reference,X and y: VY EY ≅ V_reference,Y. For every supplied native right adjunction, the reference package left comparison a_reference satisfies EY(a_K^{-1}) y_{F_native K} = c_{VX K}^{-1} F_reference(x_K) a_reference,K^{-1}. These are left-functor normalizations, with no new exceptional right comparison or right-action equation asserted.

proof.text: Restrict a fixed algebraic-closure equivalence Qbar ≃ PadicAlgCl to each finite coefficient field. Scalar extension and balanced tensor associators give the common-stage coefficient-change equivalence and its inverse. Compose the ordinary family realization with the inverse section-module presentation and geometric-fibre closure transport. Finite representative formulas give the additive and shift structures, constructible cohomology, Frobenius comparison with its shift law, and unit normalization required by Data. Lift native ordinary forgetting and its action through the fully faithful ordinary realization.

proof.text: Use the point-unit normalization and full faithfulness to lift the native point constant comparison as a coefficient Frobenius-pair isomorphism. Transport the package left comparison along the coefficient-change equivalences to define a. Retain the scalar equivalences and their F-comparison c and model isomorphisms x,y. The definition of a yields the displayed reference normalization uniformly for every supplied native adjunction.
